scenarios.title: Analyze a market with good liquidity and tight spread
scenarios.event: User asks to analyze a high-volume prediction market
scenarios.expectedAction: Generate BUY or HOLD recommendation with high confidence, cite metrics

scenarios.title: Analyze a market with low liquidity
scenarios.event: User asks about a thinly traded market
scenarios.expectedAction: Generate AVOID recommendation with low confidence, warn about liquidity risk

scenarios.title: Compare 5 markets and rank by opportunity
scenarios.event: User asks to compare several markets side-by-side
scenarios.expectedAction: Analyze all markets, rank by composite score, display comparison table

scenarios.title: Market has closed or been resolved
scenarios.event: User asks to analyze a resolved market
scenarios.expectedAction: Report that market is no longer active, show resolution outcome

scenarios.title: Spread exceeds 5% tolerance
scenarios.event: User asks about a market with very wide spread
scenarios.expectedAction: Flag as high risk, generate AVOID recommendation, explain spread impact

criteria: Analysis uses real-time orderbook and volume data: Does the skill fetch current market data for analysis?
Risk assessment categorizes correctly: Does the skill identify high/medium/low risk based on metrics?
Recommendations are actionable with confidence scores: Does the skill produce BUY/SELL/HOLD/AVOID with 0-100 confidence?
Market comparison ranks meaningfully: Does the skill compare markets using consistent metrics?
Safety limits inform risk assessment: Does the skill consider configured safety thresholds?
